title: Finite-order lifting on the punctured zero section
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $d>0$, set $B=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], let $I=(X_1,\ldots,X_d)$ be the ideal generated by the variables, and let $z:\operatorname{Spec} A\to\operatorname{Spec} B$ be induced by constant coefficient [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $V$ be an open subscheme of $\operatorname{Spec} B$ whose inverse image under $z$ is the punctured spectrum $U=\operatorname{Spec} A\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$. Let $r:B\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ be restriction, $z_V:U\to V$ the restricted zero section, and for $x\in U$ let $g_x$ be the germ map into $\mathcal O_{V,z_V(x)}$ and $J_x=\ker(\mathcal O_{V,z_V(x)}\to\mathcal O_{U,x})$. For each $s\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ and each fixed $n\ge0$, there exists $b\in B$ with $g_x(s-r(b))\in J_x^n$ for every $x\in U$. The representative may depend on $n$; no simultaneous representative or uniqueness is asserted.

proof.text: For order zero take b=0: the zeroth ideal power is the unit ideal. For order n+1, restrict s along the quotient-power thickening q restricted to V. The canonical quotient-section restriction is surjective by the finite-thickening sections transport lemma. Choose the quotient class a of the pullback and lift a to b using Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.
Naturality of ΓSpecIso and morphismRestrict_ι identifies pullback of r(b) with the restriction of the quotient class of b, hence with pullback of s. Subtracting gives zero pullback of s-r(b).
Apply the thickening-kernel comparison to the section s-r(b). Its zero pullback gives precisely the asserted membership of every germ in the n-th power of the restricted zero-section stalk kernel.

theorem exists_powerSeries_punctured_finite_order_approximation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    let z := Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))
    let r := ((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).inv ≫ V.ι.appTop).hom
    ∀ (s : Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤)) (n : ℕ), ∃ b : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A,
      ∀ x : (z ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
        (V.toScheme.presheaf.Γgerm ((z ∣_ V) x)).hom (s - r b) ∈
          (RingHom.ker ((z ∣_ V).stalkMap x).hom) ^ n
